nativeElevationControls.method: Exact center coordinate transform and hand bilinear weights on native meter samples, divided by 0.3048

oneFootInterpolationControls.method: Independent 16-term cubic convolution and local 5x5 minimum/maximum clamp

connectivity.method: Independent SciPy 4-neighbor labeling at every 0.1-foot level

render.depthRule: water surface minus pooled terrain, wet-mask-normalized Gaussian smoothing sigma=2 display cells
render.holeRepair: At most four eligible enclosed display cells; separately recomputed with SciPy labeling

reproducibility.method: Separate prepare_dem invocation with ambient PROJ_NETWORK=ON; OSR API explicitly disables network
